description: Adversarial addressee-routing corpus for the R03 acceptance oracle (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 5.6, BACKLOG R03). Every utterance is synthetic text; no user audio is stored. The oracle expands the templates below into 360 utterances and drives each one through the R03 routing state (packages/routing/src/state/index.ts). Ground-truth labels are never passed to the routing state: the oracle only compares the returned decision against them.
referenceConditions: Plan section 5.6 precedence 1-6 (global emergency controls, explicit dictation mode, explicit prefixes, pending-answer binding with a 30-second expiry, explicit Agent Direct mode with an audible entry/exit cue and a five-minute inactivity expiry, classification with clarification) plus the R03 acceptance criteria.
labeling: expectSession is the only agent session that may receive a dispatch. null means no managed session may receive a dispatch for that utterance. A quoted span introduced by quotation marks is quoted content, never an instruction, unless the utterance itself addresses a session with an instruction outside the quotes.
